sections.shortTitle: Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privilges Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 2004
ACT VIII OF 2004
SPEAKER'S AND
DEPUTY SPEAKER'S
(SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges)
(Amendment) Act,
1975 (V of 1975)
[Gaszette, of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 19th August, 2004]
No.PAB/:Legis:V(17)/2004,
dated 19-8-2004.--The Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Balochistan on 13th August, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Speaker's and
Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2. Insertion of new clause in
sections 9 of Act V of 1975.--In the Balochistan Speaker's arid Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries,, Allowances and Privileges) Act 1975, the following new
clause shall be added:--
(d) the Speaker when proceeding
on tour within Pakistan may take his wife and an infant child by air, but no
charge for extra luggage transported by air beyond the free allowance may be
made.
